laws.ti: Worker Protection (Migrant and Other Employees) Act 2023

decisions.pe: Chinese families who had overstayed their visas faced removal, and their children were born in New Zealand. The Supreme Court said officials must properly consider what removal would mean for the children.
decisions.pi: Keluarga Tiongkok yang melebihi masa visa akan dikeluarkan, dan anak-anak mereka lahir di Selandia Baru. MA menyatakan pejabat harus menimbang dengan benar dampak pengusiran bagi anak-anak.

decisions.nm: Teitiota v. Chief Executive, Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment
decisions.pe: A man from Kiribati said he could not go home because the sea was swallowing his island. The Supreme Court refused his claim but left the door open for future cases.
decisions.pi: Seorang pria dari Kiribati mengatakan ia tidak bisa pulang karena laut menenggelamkan pulaunya. MA menolak permohonannya tetapi membuka kemungkinan bagi perkara di masa depan.

decisions.pe: After he was sent back, the man took his case to the UN Human Rights Committee. It found no breach, but said that in future returning people to places made unliveable by climate change could break the treaty.
decisions.pi: Setelah dipulangkan, pria itu membawa perkaranya ke Komite HAM PBB. Komite tidak menemukan pelanggaran, tetapi menyatakan di masa depan memulangkan orang ke tempat yang tidak layak huni akibat perubahan iklim bisa melanggar perjanjian.

decisions.pe: Security risk certificate and the duty not to return a refugee to torture.
decisions.pi: Sertifikat risiko keamanan dan kewajiban tidak memulangkan pengungsi ke penyiksaan.

decisions.ct: Court of Appeal of New Zealand
decisions.pe: Samoan overstayer, his child, and international obligations.
decisions.pi: Pelanggar izin tinggal asal Samoa, anaknya, dan kewajiban internasional.

decisions.nm: Helu v. Immigration and Protection Tribunal
decisions.pe: Deportation of a Tongan resident and the weight given to family.
decisions.pi: Deportasi penduduk asal Tonga dan bobot yang diberikan kepada keluarga.

decisions.nm: Soapi and Others v Pick Hawkes Bay Inc
decisions.ct: Employment Court of New Zealand (full Court)
decisions.pe: Deductions from RSE workers' wages for accommodation and other costs breached the Wages Protection Act 1983 and Minimum Wage Act 1983; arrears ordered.
decisions.pi: Potongan upah pekerja musiman RSE untuk biaya penginapan dan biaya lain melanggar Undang-Undang Perlindungan Upah 1983 dan Undang-Undang Upah Minimum 1983; kekurangan upah wajib dibayar.

decisions.nm: Soapi v Pick Hawkes Bay Inc (interlocutory)
decisions.pe: Interlocutory judgment in the RSE deductions case (the Court agreed to hear the matter directly).
decisions.pi: Putusan sela dalam perkara potongan upah pekerja RSE (pengadilan setuju memeriksa perkara itu secara langsung).

help.de: Report migrant worker exploitation or ask about your employment rights. Free interpreters. From outside New Zealand, use the second number.
help.di: Laporkan eksploitasi pekerja migran atau tanyakan hak-hak kerja Anda. Juru bahasa gratis. Dari luar Selandia Baru, gunakan nomor kedua.

help.de: Free legal help from local centers around the country, including on migrant exploitation at work.
help.di: Bantuan hukum gratis dari pusat-pusat lokal di seluruh negeri, termasuk soal eksploitasi pekerja migran.
